operations.name: Tondrique J. Fitzgerald

expected.name: Tondrique J. Fitzgerald
expected.description: Tondrique Fitzgerald, 23, was arrested on June 1, 2020 and charged with aggravated rioting and vandalism for engaging with others to pull a granite civil rights plaque off the Historic Metro Courthouse (Nashville City Hall) wall. The plaque was smashed; pieces were used to break courthouse windows. Investigators watched Fitzgerald rip off the memorial in a Facebook Live video while encouraging others to participate. Sentenced to 48 months in Tennessee state prison.

operations.research_note: Nashville Criminal Court Clerk identifies Tondrique Fitzgerald, OCA 522913, born August 17, 1996. The vandalism case GS921874 connects this identity to the 2020 courthouse prosecution. No dates or judges from unrelated proceedings were transferred.
